Converts combat, domination, and rage into Wrath, then releases Satanael's true form at its limit.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Authority of Wrath: Can be enabled immediately after acquiring the skill; Mastery is not required. While enabled, attacking an enemy or being attacked by another entity places the user in combat. The user remains in combat for 10 seconds after the last attack dealt or received.

Magicule Proliferation Reactor
[Passive] Magicule Proliferation Reactor: Runs automatically after entering combat. It no longer appears as an active mode and does not need to be held. Restores 2% of maximum Magicules every 2.5 seconds. Each dominated enemy that remains within 30 blocks increases proliferation efficiency by 10%.

Actual recovery formula:
Maximum Magicules × 2% × (1 + dominated enemy count × 10%)

While Magicules do not exceed the natural maximum, each pulse has a 6% chance to grant 1 level of Satanael Rage. Above the natural maximum, the chance increases to 10%. Below 50% health, the chance to gain Rage increases to 150%; below 25% health, it increases to 200%.

Satanael Rage
[Passive] Rage Enhancement: Each Rage level grants +20 Armor, +100 Attack Damage, +0.6 Attack Speed, +0.2 Movement Speed, ×2 Swimming Speed, and +0.5 Knockback Resistance. Rage has a maximum of 10 levels and a base duration of 45 seconds. Attacking or being attacked extends the duration by 5 seconds, up to 60 seconds. Rage begins decaying after 10 seconds out of combat, then loses 1 level every 5 seconds. Rage does not decay during Rampage Release.

Wrath
[Passive] Wrath Accumulation: Wrath ranges from 0% to 100%. Each enemy still affected by Wrath Domination and within 30 blocks of the user generates 0.1% Wrath per second; for example, 10 enemies generate 1% per second. When no dominated enemies remain and the user is out of combat, 1% Wrath is lost per second. During Rampage Release, Wrath is fixed at 100%. When Rampage ends, Wrath is reset to zero. While Rampage Release is on cooldown, Wrath is locked at 0% and cannot be gained from any dominated enemy.

Active
[Active - Hold] Wrath Domination: Continuously consumes 100 Magicules per second and affects enemies within 30 blocks of the user, granting them Satanael Rage for 40 seconds. Scans and refreshes affected targets every 0.5 seconds. Affected creatures lose their reason and are forced to attack other creatures dominated by the same user. The user's allies and Creative Mode players are unaffected. Targets that possess and have Mental Attack Nullification enabled are completely immune. Each affected enemy contributes both Wrath and a Magicule Proliferation Reactor efficiency bonus. Grants 1 Mastery point every 5 seconds while held.

Current Rage leveling behavior: The initial base level is calculated from hold duration, normally increasing the target's Rage by 1 level every 10 seconds. A target that already has Rage also gains 1 additional level every time the effect is refreshed. Because refreshing occurs every 0.5 seconds, a continuously affected target usually reaches Rage level 10 in about 4.5 seconds.

[Active - Press] Rampage Release: Consumes all accumulated Wrath and enters Satanael's true form. Activation requires 100% Wrath, and Rampage Release must not be on cooldown.

Activation effects: Lasts 30 seconds and cannot be manually disabled after activation; clearing the passive checkbox does not end it. Wrath remains fixed at 100%. The Magicule Proliferation Reactor enters full-power operation, reducing the pulse interval to 0.5 seconds. The base proliferation multiplier starts at ×5 and increases by ×0.1 each second. Efficiency bonuses from dominated enemies still apply.

Full-power recovery formula:
Maximum Magicules × 2% × (1 + dominated enemy count × 10%) × (5 + elapsed seconds × 0.1)

Without enemy bonuses, each pulse initially restores about 10% of maximum Magicules and restores about 16% near the end. Two pulses occur each second.

Continuous growth: During Rampage, the user gains +20 Attack Damage, +5 Armor, +2% Movement Speed, and +0.05 Magicule Gain each second. After 30 seconds, the maximum gains are approximately +600 Attack Damage, +150 Armor, +60% Movement Speed, and +1.5 Magicule Gain. All of these bonuses are removed when Rampage ends.

End penalty: When Rampage ends, Wrath is reset to zero, Weakness II is applied for 2 minutes, and Rampage Release enters a 360-second cooldown. The cooldown uses the Tensura skill system's seconds unit. Wrath cannot be gained during the cooldown.

Active
[Active - Press] Harvest Storehouse: Opens the independent Harvest skill storehouse GUI. It automatically records information about Intrinsic, Common, and Extra Skills that the player formally acquires. Skills still being learned, temporary skills, resistances, Unique Skills, and Ultimate Skills are not stored. Recorded information remains even if the original skill is later integrated, consumed, or forgotten.

Ability Creation: Place information for two stored skills into the synthesis area to create a new skill according to a preset recipe. The player must actually possess both non-temporary material skills. On success, the new skill is permanently granted. By default, the player's base maximum EP is permanently reduced by 5%, and both material skills are consumed, although their information remains in the storehouse. Cooldown: 10 seconds. A failed synthesis consumes neither the material skills nor permanent EP.

Example recipes:
Self-Regeneration + Body Strengthening → Ultraspeed Regeneration
Self-Regeneration + Ultraspeed Regeneration → Infinite Regeneration
Ranged Barrier + Body Armor → Multilayer Barrier
Thought Acceleration + Analytical Appraisal → Great Sage
Spatial Motion + Multilayer Barrier → Spatial Domination

Ability Duplication: Select a stored skill that the player does not currently possess and permanently copy it to the user. Each successful duplication permanently reduces base maximum EP by 2%. Cooldown: 300 seconds. Resistances, Unique Skills, and Ultimate Skills cannot be duplicated.

Ability Bestowal: Select a skill in the storehouse and click Bestow Skill to temporarily enter Bestow mode. Aim at a named subordinate or allied player and press the skill key to grant the selected skill permanently. Maximum range: 24 blocks. A successful bestowal consumes 25% of the user's current Magicules. Cooldown: 300 seconds. Crouch and press the skill key to cancel. Resistances, Unique Skills, and Ultimate Skills cannot be bestowed.

Associated Item
Harvest Crystal: While the player possesses Harvest King, harvesting mature crops has a 1% chance to drop a Harvest Crystal. Consuming 10 Harvest Crystals unlocks permission to lock Harvest King, but the skill must still be actually locked in the skill-lock interface. Once locked, Harvest King and its storehouse data are immune to Character Reset Scrolls and Skill Reset Scrolls. If fewer than 10 crystals have been consumed, the skill was not actually locked, or configuration forbids locking it, Harvest King is reset normally and its storehouse data is also lost.

Supports the user with supreme computational ability, instantly casting magic, analyzing and restructuring skills, and taking over combat when necessary.

Passive
[Passive] Computation Enhancement: Grants +10 Chant Speed, +10 Analysis Level, +30 Skill Learning gain, and +30 Skill Mastery gain.

[Passive] Automatic Evasion: Ensures both melee and projectile automatic dodge attributes are at least 90%.

[Passive] Skill Optimization: Reduces all skill cooldowns to 70% of their original duration. Reduces the Magicule cost of all skills that consume Magicules to 70% of the original cost.

[Passive] Knowledge Infusion: Immediately learns every blueprint.

[Passive] Physical Assistance: Grants +20% Movement Speed and +1 Attack Speed.

[Passive] Additional Computation Enhancement: Grants an additional +5 Chant Speed and an additional +18 each to Skill Learning and Mastery gains.

[Passive] Magic Computation: Magic is no longer restricted by its own Mastery level and can be cast instantly.

Active
[Active - Press] Analytical Appraisal: Opens the analysis interface. Crouch and press to switch the analysis target between entities, blocks, or both.

[Active - Press] Analyze: Analyzes a creature within 10 blocks in the user's line of sight or a copyable magic projectile within 30 blocks, then randomly learns one skill that is permitted to be copied.

[Active - Press] Refinement: Press normally to open the Duplication Synthesis interface. Crouch and press to open the Refinement interface.

[Active - Press] Synthesis: Press normally to open the Disassembly interface. Crouch and press to open the Synthesis and Separation interface.

[Active - Press] Integration: Use while targeting a Charybdis Core to acquire the skill stored inside it. Cooldown: 8 seconds on success or 3 seconds on failure; with Mastery, 3 seconds on success or 1 second on failure. Costs 300 Magicules, reduced to 150 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Separation: Opens Degenerate's Separation interface and dismantles a composite into its components. Cooldown: 8 seconds on success or 3 seconds on failure; with Mastery, 3 seconds on success or 1 second on failure. Costs 200 Magicules, reduced to 100 with Mastery.

[Active - Press] Authority Management: Switches between Normal Assistance and Emergency Takeover.

Emergency Takeover: Consumes 1% of maximum Magicules per second. This cost does not benefit from Ciel's 30% cost reduction. Attacks creatures without player input and locks onto targets within 32 blocks.
